chunks: Whatever is in it from Manṣūr ibn Ḥāzim, I have narrated it from Muḥammad ibn ʿAlī Mājīlawayh—may Allah be pleased with him—from Muḥammad ibn Yaḥyā al-ʿAṭṭār, from Muḥammad ibn Aḥmad, from Muḥammad ibn ʿAbd al-Ḥamīd, from Sayf ibn ʿUmayrah, from Manṣūr ibn Ḥāzim al-Asadī al-Kūfī.

key_terms.الْأَسَدِيِّ الْكُوفِيِّ: His tribal and regional attribution: al-Asadī of Kūfah
key_terms.رَوَيْتُهُ: I transmitted it; indicates the author’s act of narration
key_terms.مَنْصُورِ بْنِ حَازِمٍ: A named transmitter from whom reports are being traced

ai.seo_question: What is the transmission chain to Manṣūr ibn Ḥāzim in Man Lā Yaḥḍuruhu al-Faqīh?
ai.summary: This passage gives the sanad/isnad through which the author transmits reports from Manṣūr ibn Ḥāzim in Man Lā Yaḥḍuruhu al-Faqīh. It is a chain-clarification statement used in hadith transmission rather than a doctrinal or legal matn.
